title: contacts-server: opt-in conditional
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9d. Crates: jmap-contacts-server. Size: M.

Apply the C7 pattern (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §7; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). register_contacts_conditional; register_contacts_handlers unchanged; memory on ScopedState + ConditionalBackend; Atomic final-state checks (single default AddressBook where specified, onDestroyRemoveContents cascade, quotas/caps). Acceptance: precondition, atomic rollback, final-state tests; conditional_ready() after opt-in; public-api additions only.
